meaning: Someone uses your name or account numbers without asking. They may open accounts or buy things as if they were you.
clues: Someone is after your private details.
The crook uses that information as if they were you.
They might open a credit card, take out a loan, or buy things in your name.
You may first learn about it from a bill or letter for something you never bought.
It has two words. The first has eight letters and starts with I.
assumes: Spyware secretly watches what you do
A romance scam asks a fake partner for money

decoys.meaning: Hidden software that secretly watches what you do on a device and sends it to someone else.
A crook pretends to be a loving partner online. After gaining trust, they ask for money.
A phone call that plays a recorded message instead of a live person.
